mapper.sql: a.apply_id, a.bot_id, a.user_id, a.tenant_id, a.auth_type, a.auth_tenant_ids, a.auth_user_ids, a.org_ids, a.bot_icon, a.bot_desc, a.audit_status, a.audit_user_id, a.audit_content, a.catalog_item_id, a.status_cd, a.creator_id, a.created_time, a.updator_id, a.updated_time, a.remark, a.data_from
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BT_BOT_AUTH_APPLY ( apply_id, bot_id, user_id, tenant_id, auth_type, auth_tenant_ids, auth_user_ids, org_ids, bot_icon, bot_desc, audit_status, audit_user_id, audit_content, catalog_item_id, status_cd, creator_id, created_time, updator_id, updated_time, remark, data_from ) VALUES ( #{dto.applyId}, #{dto.botId}, #{dto.userId}, #{dto.tenantId}, #{dto.authType}, #{dto.authTenantIds}, #{dto.authUserIds}, #{dto.orgIds}, #{dto.botIcon}, #{dto.botDesc}, #{dto.auditStatus}, #{dto.auditUserId}, #{dto.auditContent}, #{dto.catalogItemId}, #{dto.statusCd}, #{dto.creatorId}, , #{dto.updatorId}, , #{dto.remark}, #{dto.dataFrom} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM BT_BOT_AUTH_APPLY a WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.apply_id = #{applyId}

SELECT a.apply_id, a.bot_id, a.auth_type, a.auth_tenant_ids, a.auth_user_ids, a.org_ids, a.audit_status, a.audit_content, a.catalog_item_id, c.catalog_name FROM BT_BOT_AUTH_APPLY a LEFT JOIN bt_catalog c on a.catalog_item_id = c.catalog_id and c.tenant_id = -1 WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.apply_id = #{applyId}

SELECT a.apply_id, a.created_time, a.bot_desc, a.audit_status, a.audit_content, a.bot_id, a.tenant_id, b.bot_name, t.tenant_name, u.user_name, c.catalog_name, CASE WHEN b.data_from = '10A' THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END AS "isBoteClaw" FROM BT_BOT_AUTH_APPLY a LEFT JOIN bt_bot b ON a.bot_id = b.bot_id AND b.tenant_id = a.tenant_id LEFT JOIN bt_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = a.tenant_id LEFT JOIN bt_user u ON a.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN bt_catalog c on a.catalog_item_id = c.catalog_id and c.tenant_id = -1 WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.apply_id = #{applyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE BT_BOT_AUTH_APPLY SET audit_status = #{params.auditStatus}, audit_content = #{params.auditContent}, audit_user_id = #{params.auditUserId}, updator_id = #{params.auditUserId}, updated_time = WHERE apply_id = #{params.applyId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BT_BOT_AUTH_APPLY WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND audit_status = #{auditStatus}
